name: Ferrari F355 Berlinetta (1994: pop-up head lamps, 3.5 L F129B V8 with five valves a cylinder, 380 PS, six-speed manual)
axes: mm; x from the nose tip (0) back to the tail (4250); y half-width from the centre line (symmetric, positive); z from the ground at static ride height

tolerance.overall: makers' figures (the 4-view's own dimensions and the spec tables agree): length 4250, width 1900, height 1170, wheelbase 2450, overhangs 1032/768, tracks 1514/1615, tyres 225/40 ZR18 and 265/40 ZR18 (checked by web search on several spec sheets)
tolerance.profile: +-25 in z, +-30 in x (the 4-view side, read column by column)
tolerance.parts: +-40 for parts read on the 4-view; +-60 for those placed from the renders only (quarter glass tip, exhaust tips, scoop depth, engine bay)
tolerance.renders: the yellow 3D-model renders are perspective (side: ends shrunk about 5 %, the overhangs 907/711 at the wheelbase's scale); used for layout, colours and shapes, not for numbers

sources: f355_4view_dims.png: dimensioned 4-view (side, plan, front, rear), the main measuring source
render_side/front/rear/top.png: an accurate 3D model in yellow (near orthographic, some perspective): quarter glass, scoop, tail lamps, exhausts, interior colour
wire_front34.png, wire_rear34.png: wireframes (perspective): panel split and edge flow (bonnet, covers, bumper, buttresses, tail panel)
spec tables (cars-data, auto-data, parkers, wikipedia, supercarnostalgia): 4250 x 1900 x 1170, wheelbase 2450, tracks 1514/1615, 225/40 ZR18 on 7.5Jx18 front, 265/40 ZR18 on 10Jx18 rear

drawingChecks._: each view's scale checked per axis (the corrections_138 lesson) before use
drawingChecks.side: dimension ticks at px 441 (front axle = the hub's centre on the drawing) and 1370 (rear axle), tail 1655, nose 33, ground row 451, roof row 13. Wheelbase 929 px -> 2.637 mm/px along; the nose sits 408 px ahead of the axle (1075 at that scale, 43 long) and the tail 285 px behind (751, 17 short): x mapped piecewise per overhang so nose and tail land on 0 and 4250. z by the height: 1170/438 = 2.671 mm/px (1.3 % taller than x: as good as unsquashed). Front tyre 111-116 px radius = 296-310 at these scales against 319 real: the drawn wheel is a touch small, not the body
drawingChecks.plan: nose px 29, tail 1640 (crop): 2.638 mm/px along; widest 714 px at the rear wings against 1900: 2.664 mm/px across (2 % wider than along), centre row 394.5
drawingChecks.front: tyre centre ticks 1976/2545.5 = 1514: 2.658 mm/px; ground 455, roof 18: 2.677 mm/px in z (not squashed)
drawingChecks.rear: ticks 1962/2557.5 = 1615: 2.714 mm/px across; ground 1379, roof 939: 2.659 mm/px in z (2 % squashed in z against y; z taken by height)

overall.groundClearanceNote: sill foot 110-126 on the 4-view, the front lip 144-158, the flat floor 120
overall.shares: screen foot at 27 % of the length (centre) and 34 % (corners), roof 46-64 %, rear glass 64-68 %, louvred cover 69-96 %

profile._: the silhouette from the side [x, z] (highest line across the car): nose -> bonnet -> screen -> roof -> buttress top -> deck -> ducktail lip -> tail; then the underside back to the nose (wheels excluded)

runs.nose: 0-60: the bumper face nearly upright (x 5-60 between z 190 and 450), its top rolling back into the bonnet at z 465-500; the lip's foot set back (z 158 at x 80-130)
runs.bonnet: 60-1135: a long straight slope, about 18 deg at the covers easing to 10 deg at the cowl (z 812 at x 1108)
runs.cowl: 1135-1214 nearly level at 812-817 (the bonnet's vents at its back edge and the screen's foot)
runs.screen: 1214-2005 at about 24 deg on the centre line, curving into the roof
runs.buttress: 2664-3536: the flying buttresses' top edge, a straight fall from the roof's back corners to their tips (z 863 at x 3536); between them the upright rear glass and the louvred engine cover, lower (not in the silhouette)
runs.deck: 3536-3970: the cover's back and the deck at 857-836
runs.lip: 3970-4100: the ducktail lip rising to 879 at x 4048, its trailing edge at 4100 (z 857)
runs.tail: the tail panel under the lip leans back from x 4118 (z 830) to 4177 (z 617); the bumper steps out to its face at 4250 (z 596-510) and tucks under to 4200 (z 380-450); below it the black lower grille and the exhausts (z 200-330)

plan._: half-width at the widest line (the shoulder crease), mirrors excluded; the plan's across-scale normalised to the 1900 width

bonnet.note: the front lid's shut lines run straight back at y +-427; two dark vents across its back edge (x 1005-1050, y 40-410 each side)

roof.halfWidth: 480 flat, rolling down to the rail at 560-590

rearGlass.note: upright window sunk between the buttresses: top 1130 at x 2730, foot 900 at 2900 (plan: the narrow white strip x 2778-2898)

buttress.note: the flying buttresses: dark inner faces seen from above (the plan's black wedges), pointed tips at x 3565 y 645

engineCover.slots: 12 slots a side, pitch 77 (x 3085-3990), each 35 wide, y 190-450; the raised centre panel x 3200-3580, y +-220

sections._: heights of the lines along the flank, [x, z]
sections.beltNote: the side glass's foot; behind the B pillar the quarter glass's foot rises to its tip (x 3150-3250, z about 875, render)
sections.creaseNote: one shoulder crease round the car: the bumper's top line at the nose (z 500), rising gently along the door to 600 over the rear wing, the widest line; it also caps the side scoop

front.shape: round with a slight lip; the wing rises over it

panels._: each its own surface meeting the next at a shared edge
panels.1_frontBumper: below the crease (z 500), x 0-675: the oval grille, the turn lamp slots, round fog lamps, the splitter lip
panels.2_bonnet: between y +-427 from x 190 to 1058, the vents at its back edge
panels.3_popupCovers: x 160-460, y 445-735, flush when down, hinged at their back edge
panels.4_frontWings: nose corners over the front wheel to the door (x 1487); their tops round off into the crease
panels.5_glasshouse: screen (body-colour A pillars), roof in body colour, door glass, black B pillar (x 2600-2680), quarter glass to its tip (3250)
panels.6_doors: x 1487-2700; the scoop starts in the door
panels.8_sills: z 118-250, a lip at 250 and the dark sill slot (x 1900-2600, z 185-240) under the scoop
panels.9_rearWings: from the door to the tail, rising into the buttresses
panels.12_engineCover: louvred (see plan.engineCover), the V8's red intakes between the slots
panels.13_lip: the ducktail across the tail, x 3970-4100
panels.14_tailPanel: x 4118-4177, z 617-850: the black slot with the script (z 807-845, y +-610), four round lamps, the horse
panels.15_rearBumper: face at 4250 (z 510-596) with the plate recess, a black line at 408, the black lower grille with the exhausts (z 228-332), valance below
panels.sideScoop: a deep tapering channel from the door's front third (x 1550, 0 deep, z 330-530) back to the intake ahead of the rear wheel (x 2650, 110 deep): its top edge under the crease (z 525-545), its foot at 330-300; the rear end rounded, the last 250 mm dark (the intake); the sill's lip below it

engineBay._: longitudinal F129B V8 (90 deg, five valves a cylinder) behind the cabin under the louvred cover; gearbox behind it under the tail

engine.note: bellhousing at x 3800, pulleys forward at 3230; the red crinkle intakes along the banks show between the slots
